requirements.req_text: Hazards and First Aid. (c) Discuss how the safety gear carried by SAR team members in their field packs addresses SAR hazards.

Course Serves Basis: This course serves as the basis for moreadvanced courses in emergency management.
Incident Command System: The Incident Command System uses five key concepts.
step_by_step_procedure: Unity Command Refers: Unity of command refers to the conceptthat each person or resource responding to a scene reports toonly one supervisor.
